title: Second alien communicator nicknamed Bones

tellings.quote: >> No, this was a different one.

plain: Between 1990 and 1993, at a site he calls Base 2, a second alien Dan Sherman was in contact with went by the nickname Bones. Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, tells Michels this was not the being he had dealt with before: "No, this was a different one." If true, it would mean more than one alien was in contact with the program.
